dedicated_video_mb.meaning: driver/BIOS-reported dedicated segment; on an integrated APU this is a carve-out, NOT independent physical VRAM

dedicated_system_mb.meaning: system memory dedicated to the adapter segment

shared_system_mb.meaning: system RAM the GPU is allowed to share; not VRAM

wmi_adapter_ram_bytes.meaning: uint32 field; saturates near 4 GiB and is unreliable for >4 GiB devices; do NOT use as VRAM capacity

memory.measurement_status: DXGI_STATIC_ENUMERATION_ONLY; runtime VRAM usage, bandwidth, temperature and power are NOT_MEASURED

conclusion: Three different measurement calibers; WMI AdapterRAM saturates at uint32 4GiB and must not be used as VRAM. Runtime VRAM usage/bandwidth/temperature/power remain NOT_MEASURED.
